scripts.//dev: Local dev runs on SQLite while the deploy target is Postgres, so the client has to be generated from a sqlite-provider schema or @prisma/adapter-libsql refuses to load. Regenerated every time rather than once, because `npm run build` and `postinstall` both flip it back to Postgres.
scripts.dev: node scripts/local-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.local.prisma && tsx src/server.ts
scripts.//start: Migrations run at start, not build: on Render the persistent disk holding the database is only mounted at runtime, so a build-time migrate would target a throwaway filesystem.
scripts.start: node scripts/pre-migrate.mjs && prisma migrate deploy && node dist/seed.js && node dist/server.js
